_comment: Spatial words drawn as a picture, not searched for and not clozed (tunatale-hvj0, the user 2026-09-28: 'they become picture cards'). Each maps a word to a language-neutral concept in app.cards.spatial_scenes.SPATIAL_CONCEPTS. A word listed here is NOT a function word, whatever `function_words.json` or a POS tag says: app.srs.function_words.is_function_word vetoes it, so it cards as vocab and its image is drawn. The picture is only drawn when the card's English gloss names the relation (app.cards.spatial_picture.gloss_matches), which is what keeps a homograph's other sense off the picture. Map only words whose MAIN sense is spatial: the case marker 'sa' stays a cloze. 'wala' (none / left), 'tuo' (right / believe) and 'tunga' (half / middle) are homographs: they are listed, and the gloss guard draws them only on a card glossed with the spatial sense. ORCHESTRATOR-DRAFTED, not native-checked.
